newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends barely higher, trade narrow.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends barely higher, trade narrow.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures set their nine-point trading range early and floated quietly above unchanged through the close as values consolidated recent losses, market sources said.

Speculative shortcovering gave the market an initial boost while locals were also light buyers. Steady trade selling kept prices below resistance at 10.40 cents a lb for March delivery, dealers said. Firmer resistance was pegged at 10.50. Light support was pegged at today's low of 10.30 and major support at 10.23.
The spot month closed 0.01 firmer at 10.31 cents, traded 10.39 to 10.30. The back months finished 0.02 to 0.05 higher.
While the settlement just above the day's lows does not bode well for a rally, the market will probably not make a major downward move unless firm support is taken out.
"If it gets through 10.23 (for March), we will hit some sell stops," a dealer said.
